title: QuantCase input v1
description: Domain case payload from which the Quant adapter derives an EvaluationContract. gates declares the promotion gates a study must clear; each gate is one evidentiary tier from the quant gate family. The forbidden channels and Q-checkpoints on the derived contract are fixed by ADR-0005 decision 5, not by the case author.

gates.description: Promotion gates of the case, at least one. Each gate becomes one contract entry; the adapter deduplicates repeated gates when deriving the contract.
